headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Maruti Suzuki India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
summary: Q1 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹52,470 Cr (+35.9% YoY, +0.0% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹4,313 Cr (-6.7% YoY, margin 8.2%); PAT ₹3,447 Cr (-9.1% YoY, -5.8% QoQ).
raw_text: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

derivation.basis_note: Statement of Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results (PDF p. 4 via vision, reported in ₹ Million; normalised ÷10 to ₹ crore).
derivation.revenue_definition: Total Revenue from Operations (Net Sales + Operating Income) = ₹5,24,698 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹52,469.80 Cr.
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹5,24,698 Mn − Total Expenses ₹5,00,003 Mn = ₹24,695 Mn) + Finance Costs (₹635 Mn) + Depreciation & Amortisation (₹17,803 Mn) = ₹43,133 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹4,313.30 Cr (8.22% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Tax (including Share of Profit of Associates; no exceptional items) = ₹44,412 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹4,441.20 Cr.
derivation.pat_basis: Total Consolidated Profit for the period = ₹34,469 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹3,446.90 Cr (100% attributable to owners of the company: ₹3,446.90 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ million (Page 4 via vision) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii
